title: Route VOX shots through the supported image pipeline
description: Keep the simplified VOX Documentary flow on the existing validated image-asset pipeline instead of selecting unsupported stock-video or document acquisition routes.
businessContext: Asset Acquisition and downstream timeline persistence currently support validated image assets only. The legacy visual router can select stock_video, document, and diagram routes that have no compatible automatic adapter, preventing the VOX flow from reaching Scene Review.
acceptanceCriteria: VOX Documentary routing preserves approved local assets and routes new shots to the existing ai_image path.
Legacy visual routing keeps its existing stock-video, document, diagram, and ai-image decisions when no VOX policy is requested.
The simplified VOX route no longer creates an automatic Asset Acquisition request for an unsupported media type.
Focused visual-router checks, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/domain/test/visualRouter.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/assetAcquisitionService.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: Making VOX routing work would require adding a video asset schema, new persistence, or a new provider adapter.
